shortDescription: AstraZeneca Plc’s breast cancer pill won approval from the US Food and Drug Administration, according to Bloomberg.The decision is a win for AstraZeneca after the agency’s advisory panel previously voted against the medicine.

title: GEOPOLITICS | FDA Approves AstraZeneca Breast Cancer Pill
